lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a characteristic grid-like anchor structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five commensal organisms (remoras) is visible near the ventral midline, posterior to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
